archfiend.settings.title: Archfiend Settings
archfiend.settings.enabled.tooltip: Play a slot-machine sequence when an RNG drop is announced in chat.
archfiend.settings.style.tooltip:
Reel: horizontal case-opening strip.
Slot Machine: three reels with a lever.
Treasure Chest: a 3D chest drops in, bursts open and a glowing question mark reveals the item.
World Chest: the chest is a real object that drops into the world and tumbles with physics before it bursts open.
archfiend.settings.min_tier.tooltip: Lowest drop tier that triggers a sequence. Lower tiers are shown in chat as normal.
archfiend.settings.delay_chat.tooltip: Hold the drop message back until the reel lands, so chat can't spoil the result.
archfiend.settings.spin.tooltip: How long the reels spin before landing. The slot machine adds a short stagger per reel.
archfiend.settings.reveal.tooltip: How long the result stays on screen after landing.
archfiend.settings.scale.tooltip: Size of the machine. It also adapts to your GUI scale automatically.
archfiend.settings.volume.tooltip: Volume of the spin clicks and reveal fanfare.
archfiend.settings.tease.tooltip: Mix fake high-tier symbols and your earlier drops into the generic reel. Ignored when a real loot table is used.
archfiend.settings.near_miss.tooltip: Place the best other symbol right after the winning slot, so it almost lands on it.
archfiend.settings.hide_hud.tooltip: Hide the hotbar, health, scoreboard, chat and your hand while a sequence plays, so nothing distracts from (or spoils) the roll.
archfiend.settings.repo_enabled.tooltip: Download the NotEnoughUpdates item repo for real SkyBlock icons and mob loot tables.
archfiend.settings.repo_auto_update.tool: Check GitHub for a newer repo version every time the game starts.
archfiend.settings.loot_tables.tooltip: Fill the reels with the real drops of the mob that dropped the item, weighted by drop chance.
archfiend.settings.repo_update.tooltip: Click to download the latest version now.
archfiend.settings.preview.tooltip: Close this screen and play a test sequence for your Min Tier. Only available in a world.
